title: A/R Detail: the CSV has one row per document and no group rows
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two overdue invoices on today's date in different aging buckets: {Invoice-A}, dated 2026-09-01, amount $1,250.50, and {Invoice-B}, amount $75.00.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-20 Flat Rows.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the Customer filter showing {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the CSV in a plain text editor.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: the heading row has a column for the aging bucket and one for the customer; one row for {Invoice-A}: its aging bucket is in its own column, {Customer-A} in the customer column, the Date reads 2026-09-01 and the Amount reads 1250.50 (no $ sign, no thousands comma, two decimals); one row for {Invoice-B} and no group header or subtotal row; one Totals row at the bottom, whose Amount is 1325.50 (1250.50 + 75.00).

The CSV headings for the bucket and the customer columns are not stated in the PRD (question 8); the case checks that the columns exist.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R8: “The CSV is one flat table: one row per customer or vendor (Summaries) or per document (Detail, Collection, Unpaid Invoices), with the aging bucket, customer or vendor in its own column; no group header or subtotal rows; one Totals row at the bottom. Money is a plain number with two decimals, and an empty bucket is a blank cell; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
